area: Salon approval before go-live, and admin review visibility

corrections.original_claim: SILENT NO-OP. PATCH /api/admin/salons/[id]/freeze writes only frozen_at and frozen_reason, never is_active=false ... A frozen salon therefore stays fully listed and bookable. This is a money-touching silent no-op.
corrections.truth: Three errors. (1) The method is POST, not PATCH: app/api/admin/salons/[id]/freeze/route.ts:11 `export async function POST`. (2) It does NOT write 'only frozen_at and frozen_reason'. Beyond the updateData at :40-43 it batch-cancels every pending_approval/confirmed booking (:50-61), issues a full remaining-balance refund per booking through issueRefund (:68-88), releases the availability slots (:90-92), inserts an account_actions suspension row (:95-100) and audit-logs (:102). Calling that a no-op is backwards; it is the most side-effect-heavy admin route in the set. (3) The consequence is unreachable: I grepped the whole repo for callers of the freeze path and found ZERO. The only UI 'Freeze' button (app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:284) routes to handleToggle at :120-142, which calls /reject at :129-133. No salon can be frozen from the product at all today, so 'a frozen salon stays listed and bookable' cannot currently happen. The underlying code defect (is_active untouched at :40-43, no listing query filters frozen_at) is real, but it is dormant, not live.
corrections.evidence: app/api/admin/salons/[id]/freeze/route.ts:11 (POST), :40-43 (updateData), :50-93 (cancel+refund cascade), :95-100 (account_actions), :102 (audit). Caller grep over *.ts/*.tsx/*.mjs/*.js repo-wide: only route-internal hits, plus lib/validations.ts:797 and scripts/ring7a-kill-test.ts:142 which reference the shared schema, never the endpoint.

corrections.original_claim: Same shape in the 3-strike path: warn sets frozen_at + frozen_reason at warning_count >= 3 and leaves is_active untouched, so a 3-strike salon keeps taking bookings.
corrections.truth: The code is exactly as described: app/api/admin/salons/[id]/warn/route.ts:39-46 increments warning_count, and at newCount >= 3 adds only frozen_at + frozen_reason, never is_active. But the stated consequence cannot occur, because the warn route has ZERO callers repo-wide (same grep as freeze). No admin can issue a warning from any UI, so warning_count can never reach 3 through the product and the auto-freeze branch is unreachable. Also note warn, unlike freeze, does NOT cancel or refund bookings, so if it were ever wired it would be the weaker of the two paths. The route is POST (:10), not PATCH.
corrections.evidence: app/api/admin/salons/[id]/warn/route.ts:10 (POST), :39-46 (updateData), :48 (single update call, no is_active). No fetch to a warn endpoint exists in app/, components/, components-legacy/, lib/ or scripts/.

corrections.original_claim: SILENT NO-OP / dead-code: cover_photo_url is selected by the admin API but ... no img/Image renders on that page, so an admin approves a salon without ever seeing its photo.
corrections.truth: True only for /approvals, and the 'dead-code' classification at the API level is wrong. The other admin consumer of the same endpoint renders it: app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:24 declares cover_photo_url on its AdminSalon interface and :230 renders it with next/image (`<Image src={salon.cover_photo_url} fill className="object-cover" />`) under a 'Cover thumbnail' comment at :227. That page also has a 'pending' tab (TAB_VALUES at :34, fetch at :107-113 hitting /api/admin/salons?status=${status}), so an admin CAN view pending salons WITH the cover photo and a status pill, just on /dashboard/all-salons rather than /dashboard/approvals. The field is live, not dead.
corrections.evidence: app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:4 (next/image import), :24 (interface field), :34 (TAB_VALUES includes pending), :107-113 (same endpoint), :227-230 (render). Contrast app/[locale]/dashboard/approvals/page.tsx:11-20 (field absent) and :107-139 (no image).

corrections.original_claim: Summary: 'the admin sees name, owner email, address, created_at and category chips, and nothing else.'
corrections.truth: That is the /approvals card only. The pending tab of /dashboard/all-salons additionally shows the cover photo thumbnail, a computed status pill (active/pending/frozen, derived at :42-49), the slug, phone, and a name+owner_email search box (:144-148). The review surface is thin, but not as thin as stated, and any fix should extend the richer page rather than assume both are equally bare.
corrections.evidence: app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:17-32 (AdminSalon interface carries slug, phone, cover_photo_url, is_active, registration_completed, approved_at, rejection_reason, owner_email), :42-49 (getStatusPill), :144-148 (search), :227-230 (thumbnail), :275 (DashStatusPill).

corrections.original_claim: (not claimed by the recon) The admin review UI's per-row controls are correctly targeted.
corrections.truth: MISSED SILENT NO-OP, and it is the classic shape this repo warns about. The per-row 'Edit' control on /dashboard/all-salons is an anchor whose href is `/${locale}/dashboard/settings` with NO salon identifier of any kind. Clicking it on ANY salon row navigates the admin to their OWN salon settings page, which resolves its salon from the session (app/[locale]/dashboard/settings/page.tsx takes no id param; its fetches key off an internally-resolved `salon.id`, e.g. :1044, :1229). So the control looks like 'edit this salon' and cannot possibly edit the row it sits on.
corrections.evidence: app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:295-300 (` {t("edit")} `, no salon.id interpolated); app/[locale]/dashboard/settings/page.tsx has no [id] segment and no salon_id query read.

corrections.original_claim: SILENT NO-OP. ... possible_duplicate_of. Nothing renders it — the consuming interface omits it: app/[locale]/dashboard/approvals/page.tsx:11-20
corrections.truth: Confirmed, and it is worse than stated: BOTH consumers of the endpoint drop the field, not just /approvals. app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:17-32 also omits possible_duplicate_of from its AdminSalon interface. The extra full-table address scan at app/api/admin/salons/route.ts:59 runs on every load of either page and feeds nothing.
corrections.evidence: Computed app/api/admin/salons/route.ts:45-77, returned :82. Absent from app/[locale]/dashboard/approvals/page.tsx:11-20 AND app/[locale]/dashboard/all-salons/page.tsx:17-32.

corrections.original_claim: A salon created via signup ... listed_on_marketplace is not set by the insert at all (left to DB default), so is_active alone is what holds the door shut.
corrections.truth: Correct conclusion, but the recon never checked the default it depends on. I did: listed_on_marketplace is `boolean DEFAULT true` (supabase/migrations/20260602120000_walkin_foundations.sql:43), so a new salon is indeed gated by is_active alone and becomes visible the moment approve flips it. Worth flagging a coupling the recon missed: a NOT VALID-then-VALIDATED CHECK, salons_listed_requires_module_chk, requires `NOT listed_on_marketplace OR online_booking_enabled OR walkin_enabled` (:57-64). New inserts pass only because online_booking_enabled also defaults true (:42). If that default ever flips, every signup insert starts failing the constraint.
corrections.evidence: supabase/migrations/20260602120000_walkin_foundations.sql:41-46 (defaults), :57-64 (constraint). Insert omits all three keys: app/api/salons/route.ts:683-723.

corrections.original_claim: BLOCKING BUG ... the ONLY writer of registration_completed=true anywhere in the repo is the admin test-salon seeder ... a real registered salon is [garbled] invisible to the approvals queue.
corrections.truth: Fully reproduced, and I additionally closed the gap the recon left open by confirming the real signup path actually reaches that insert: app/[locale]/onboarding/salon/page.tsx:494-519 POSTs to /api/salons, and on success only clears the wizard draft and redirects (:525-528), never touching registration_completed. Filter at app/api/admin/salons/route.ts:29, sole writer at app/api/admin/test-salon/route.ts:100, default false at supabase/migrations/015_admin_approval.sql:4, insert omits the key at app/api/salons/route.ts:683-723 (is_active:false at :716). Scoped grep over app/lib/components/components-legacy/scripts/supabase returns exactly those sites plus 4 type defs and one UI interface field. One caveat the recon should have stated: I could NOT check live DB triggers or live column defaults, because _inventory/_db-snapshot.json records only {name, rows, rls} per table. The 'default false' rests on the migration file alone, and this repo's own rule is that migrations drift.
corrections.evidence: app/[locale]/onboarding/salon/page.tsx:494-528; app/api/admin/salons/route.ts:29; app/api/admin/test-salon/route.ts:100; app/api/salons/route.ts:716; supabase/migrations/015_admin_approval.sql:4; _inventory/_db-columns.json columns.salons contains registration_completed (capturedAt 2026-07-12).

net_picture:
The recon's headline is right and I could not break it. There IS a real approval system (two admin pages, a list API, approve/reject endpoints that write approved_at/approved_by/rejection_reason, audit logging, owner emails, an owner-facing go-live gate, and a DB guard trigger), and its feed is structurally dead: the pending query requires salons.registration_completed = true (app/api/admin/salons/route.ts:29), the only writer of that column is the admin test-salon seeder (app/api/admin/test-salon/route.ts:100), and the real signup path (app/[locale]/onboarding/salon/page.tsx:494 -> app/api/salons/route.ts:683-723) never sets it. So a genuinely registered salon never enters the queue, never gets approved_at, and POST /api/salon/go-live 403s it forever (go-live/route.ts:56-58), with the DB trigger blocking self-activation independently. 17 of 21 claims reproduce exactly.

Four things the recon got wrong, and they all cut the same way: it overstated the moderation findings and understated the review surface.

Freeze is the big miss. It is POST, not PATCH; it is not a no-op that "writes only frozen_at and frozen_reason" (it cancels every active booking, issues Stripe refunds through issueRefund, releases slots, writes account_actions, and audit-logs); and neither freeze nor warn has a single caller anywhere in the repo. The UI "Freeze" button calls /reject instead. So the recon's one money-touching live finding is not live: no admin can freeze or warn anything today. The is_active omission in both routes is a real latent defect to fix before wiring them, not a hole customers are falling through.

On the review surface, the recon only looked at /approvals. /dashboard/all-salons hits the same endpoint, has a pending tab, and DOES render the cover photo (next/image at :230) plus a status pill and search. cover_photo_url is not dead code. The right move is to deepen that page, not treat both as equally bare.

I found one silent no-op the recon missed, and it is the exact shape this codebase warns about: the per-row "Edit" control on all-salons (:295-300) hrefs /${locale}/dashboard/settings with no salon id, so on every row it sends the admin to their OWN settings page. A control that looks wired to the row and is wired to nothing.

Two claims needed evidence the recon never gathered but that hold up: listed_on_marketplace defaults true (walkin_foundations.sql:43), which is what makes "is_active alone holds the door shut" correct, and it only passes the salons_listed_requires_module_chk constraint because online_booking_enabled also defaults true. And "~50 hand-rolled admin checks" is exactly 54 of 54 route files, with lib/auth/require.ts:72 requireAdmin at zero importers.

Everything else reproduces: rejected_at is a live column with zero application readers or writers; salon_documents has no admin read path and its status/reviewed_by/reviewed_at/admin_note columns are only ever NULLed by the deletion cron; lib/salon-detail.ts:75-76 blocks admins from pending PDPs while the comment at :74 claims otherwise (chain confirmed through loadSalonDetailWithStatus:205 -> loadSalonDetail:186 -> loadSalonDetailWithAccess:31); preview-salon refuses anything not named [TEST]; there is no GET under app/api/admin/salons/[id]/; notify-new-salon is admin-gated with a source comment admitting it has no caller.

One limit the recon asserted past and I will not: nobody here checked the live database. _inventory/_db-snapshot.json stores only {name, rows, rls} per table, so live column defaults and live triggers are unverified. "registration_completed defaults to false" and "guard_salon_activation is installed" both rest on migration files, which this repo's own rules say drift. Before shipping the one-line fix, confirm the default and the trigger against the live schema, and prove the queue DISCRIMINATES (a salon created through the real form appears in status=pending and leaves after approve), not merely that the endpoint returns 200.
